description:
Convert an audio clip to sound like a different voice (voice conversion).

WHEN TO USE:
- Change the speaker voice of an existing recording while preserving timing
- Apply a premade or cloned voice_id to source audio the user provides as a file

EXAMPLE: {"audio_path": "/path/to/source.mp3", "voice_id": "21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM"}

RELATED TOOLS:
- list_voices / get_voice: resolve voice_id
- generate_speech: synthesize new speech from text instead of converting audio
- check_subscription: confirm credits before conversion

RETURNS: file_path and size_bytes for the converted audio (saved under MCP_WORKSPACE_PATH, or os.tmpdir() when unset).

COST: Credits based on source audio duration.

audio_path.description: Absolute path to local source audio. When connected to a host that authorizes file reads, its path permission decision applies; standalone clients require the file inside MCP_WORKSPACE_PATH (or os.tmpdir()).

model_id.description: STS model ID. Omit to use the API default.

remove_background_noise.description: When true, reduce background noise during conversion. Default: false.

voice_id.description: Target voice ID from list_voices or search_shared_voices.

voice_settings.description: Optional voice settings JSON object (stability, similarity_boost).

name: speech_to_speech
